messages:
jess: quick q — for auto-fallback UX: two controls (p95, error%) or one combined slider?
ryan: two. errors vs latency need separate handling.
priya: two + presets (low/balanced/high). advanced panel collapsed.
jess: defaults suggested: p95=400ms, err=1% for hosted. per-route overrides for embeddings/chat.
ryan: show exactly which event types count (5xx, timeouts, model_reject).
priya: preview sim: estimated_switch_pct based on sampled last-72h telemetry (default 5% sample).
ops-bot: note: heavy queries; sampler should cap at 5% and windowed scans.
sam: audit defaults: canary=10%, auto-fallback=1%, optional "capture payload" toggle (default off).
priya: operator override requires reason + optional TTL; record audit event.
ryan: add hysteresis: min_switch_interval & exponential backoff to avoid flapping.
jess: playback API stub: GET /api/v1/rollouts/{id}/playback?from=&to=&sample_pct=. require operator role + access logs.
priya: I'll draft runbook text and UI microcopy. jess: I'll mock console with two fields, presets, rule builder, preview pane, hysteresis, cost/privacy badge, and timeline. prototype tomorrow morning.
